question:
(i) Prove, from first principles, that
\[
(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^n=\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta,
\]
for every positive integer \(n\).

(ii) Prove that
\[
(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^n=\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta,
\]
for every negative integer \(n\).

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
